app.title: Sonograph
app.tagline: Real-time pitch detection in the browser

about.title: About Sonograph
about.tagline: A tuner for matching the pitch of your instrument or voice
about.overview: Play or sing into the microphone and Sonograph shows the current pitch and how far above or below it is, in real time.

features.display: See your pitch right away (green when it's in tune)
features.adjust: Match your instrument (transposition, reference pitch, do-re-mi or C-D-E)
features.record: Record your playing to listen back or download
features.practice: Practice with the metronome and reference tone

howTo.play: Play or sing — your pitch appears
howTo.adjust: Use settings to match your instrument and preferences

autoStart.label: Start automatically next time
autoStart.hint: Starts the microphone automatically on your next visit

referenceFrequency.label: Reference frequency (A4)
referenceFrequency.hint: 440 Hz is standard; orchestras commonly use 442 Hz

transposition.label: Transposition
transposition.hint: Shifts the displayed note names for transposing instruments

centThreshold.label: Cent threshold
centThreshold.hint: Within this range the pitch is judged in tune (shown green)

temperament.label: Temperament
temperament.hint: Just intonation makes chords ring purely

noiseGate.label: Noise gate
noiseGate.hint: Pitch detection is skipped below this level (higher means less sensitive)

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.description: Recordings are kept for 7 days, then deleted automatically.

toast.saveSuccess: Recording saved — find it in the recordings list.
